description: Source code for Zigbee Legacy Siren Repeater device driver, implementing device claiming, configuration, resource registration, firmware upgrade, and event handling for Zigbee devices within a specific project.

methods.name: zigbeeLegacySirenRepeaterDriverInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Zigbee Legacy Siren Repeater device driver, sets up callbacks, creates cluster, and configures driver properties.

methods.name: claimDevice
methods.description: Claims a device based on device type and details, using legacy security cluster.

methods.name: initiateFirmwareUpgrade
methods.description: Triggers firmware upgrade process for a device identified by UUID.

methods.name: devicesLoaded
methods.description: Handles event when devices are loaded, passing them to the security cluster.

methods.name: configureDevice
methods.description: Configures a device with the security cluster.

methods.name: fetchInitialResourceValues
methods.description: Fetches initial resource values from the device for setup.

methods.name: registerResources
methods.description: Registers resources and creates endpoints/resources on the device.

methods.name: isGodparentPingSupported
methods.description: Determines if godparent ping is supported based on firmware version.

methods.name: deviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Handles status change events from the device, updating resources.

methods.name: deviceInfoReceived
methods.description: Handles reception of device info, such as firmware version.

methods.name: writeEndpointResource
methods.description: Writes a value to a device endpoint resource, e.g., setting siren tone.

methods.name: upgradeInProgress
methods.description: Indicates whether a firmware upgrade is in progress.

methods.name: mapDeviceIdToProfile
methods.description: Maps device ID to device profile string.

methods.name: postDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a device is removed.
